name: Combobox
description: A text field that filters a list as you type, then keeps the option you pick.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid, with an alert icon.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

props.name: size
props.description: Field height of 32, 36 or 44 pixels, matching Input.

props.name: defaultItems
props.description: Options for a dynamic list, filtered by what is typed. Render each one with a function as children.

props.name: items
props.description: Options you filter yourself (controlled), for example from a server.

props.name: children
props.description: ComboBoxItem elements, or a function that renders one per entry of items.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown in the list when nothing matches what was typed.

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.description: Keep typed text that matches no option as the value.

props.name: allowsEmptyCollection
props.description: Keep the list open with the empty state when nothing matches. Set false to close it instead.

props.name: menuTrigger
props.description: What opens the list: typing, focusing the field, or only the chevron button.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's id (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the chosen option changes.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The typed text (controlled). Use defaultInputValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called as the text changes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia outline and the error message.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ComboBox.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the option in value.

props.name: children
props.description: The label.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain text that is matched against what is typed and written into the field. Taken from children when they are a string.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, muted line under the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon before the label.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Image source for a round avatar before the label.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables this option.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading above the group.

props.name: items
props.description: Options for a dynamic section.

props.name: children
props.description: The section's ComboBoxItem elements.
